create.name: Two Arrows Zen
create.bio:
Two Arrows Zen is a Zen centre in Utah with two places to practise: a city zendo on G Street in the Avenues district of Salt Lake City and a retreat zendo in Torrey, close to Capitol Reef National Park. Its founders are a married couple, Diane Musho Hamilton Roshi, a mediator and author on Zen and conflict, and Michael Mugaku Zimmerman Roshi, a former Chief Justice of the Utah Supreme Court. They ordained together in 2003, received dharma transmission from Genpo Merzel in 2006 and later inka from Sidney Musai Walter. The centre sits in the White Plum lineage, with Soto transmission and a strong Rinzai influence, and it marked twenty years of practice in 2026.

Besides sitting, study and ritual, Two Arrows gives time to communication, relationships and emotional maturity so that what is learned on the cushion carries into ordinary and civic life. Zimmerman leads weekday morning sittings in Salt Lake City and Hamilton a Thursday evening sit, service and talk, while a Sunday morning programme meets at Artspace City Center. Week-long sesshin in Torrey bring together people on site and online, an urban Rohatsu sesshin runs each December, online study courses fill the year, and recorded talks are free on the website.

courses.title: Rohatsu Winter Sesshin in Torrey 2026
courses.description: A silent week of intensive zazen with Diane Musho Hamilton Roshi at the Torrey zendo, joined by online participants, with short talks, interviews for newer students, work practice and walks in the desert. All meals are included and participants stay for the whole retreat.
courses.price: $959 for Two Arrows Zen Members; $1079 General Admission

courses.title: Rohatsu Sesshin 2026 with Mugaku Roshi
courses.description: A four-day city retreat at the G Street zendo in Salt Lake City marking the Buddha's awakening, sitting from early morning to late afternoon with services, private interviews with Michael Mugaku Zimmerman Roshi, shared work and meals.
courses.price: $419 Two Arrows Zen Members; $469 General Admission

courses.title: Sunday Wake Up: Meditation, Clarity, & Community
courses.description: A weekly Sunday morning gathering at Artspace City Center with tea, a period of sitting, a talk by Diane Musho Hamilton Roshi or a senior student and open discussion, suitable for beginners and seasoned sitters. Once a month it runs longer with extra sitting.
courses.price: $10 per week at the door, or a Two Arrows Zen Membership

courses.title: Thursday Evening Sit and Dharma Talk
courses.description: Weekly evening practice at the G Street zendo with the Dragon Heart Sangha: a period of zazen, a Zen service and a talk by Musho Roshi or senior practitioners, with a sangha potluck on the first Thursday of the month.
courses.price: Monthly membership; newcomers attend free for their first month

free_resources.title: Dharma Talk Audio
free_resources.description: Recorded talks by the two founding teachers, grouped as an introduction to Zen, continuous practice, attention, emotions and feelings, and meditation.

free_resources.title: Daily Meditation
free_resources.description: Two periods of weekday morning zazen with walking meditation at the G Street zendo, led by Mugaku Roshi with a short Friday talk, open to anyone for either or both sittings.

Lineage note for the owner: the founders received transmission from Dennis Genpo Merzel, who left his role after a 2011 misconduct controversy; the allegations concern him, not Two Arrows' current teachers, so the plan is not held.
Diane Musho Hamilton has written several Shambhala books and is a possible future individual listing; she also runs Real LIFE facilitation programmes (a separate organisation, not listed here).
